verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs say payroll taxes are "calculated, filed and paid for you." They also say ADP handles tax filing for employees working across multiple state or local jurisdictions, and a tax-filing guarantee covers penalties from ADP errors. Together this covers calculation, filing and remittance at federal, state and local levels. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs that break down federal, state and local filing and remittance mechanics; independent or hands-on corroboration that tax remittance works automatically.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have federal, state, and local payroll taxes calculated, filed, and remitted automatically

citations.quote: have payroll taxes calculated, filed and paid for you
Easily pay employees who work in more than one state or local jurisdiction in the same pay period — and we’ll handle the tax filing for you.
if we make a tax filing error, we pay the resulting fines or penalties imposed by the taxing authorities for you.
